details: imgdecode (versions 1.0.0 to 1.0.3, published 2026-09-30 to 2026-10-11 by npm user malfexteste8; 979 downloads 2026-09-13 to 2026-10-12) loads a prebuilt Windows x64 native module (prebuilds/win32-x64/imgdecode.node) on require. The module's imports include WinINet URL download (InternetOpenUrlA, InternetReadFile), BCrypt symmetric decryption, VirtualProtect and temp-path access. The exported load() returns null and the README documents an exec() function that does not exist. PDB path: C:\Users\Administrator\Desktop\npm\imgdecode\build\Release\imgdecode.pdb. Consistent with the image-decrypting loader of the MALFEX npm campaign named by Checkmarx and CloudSEK; the payload URL is not stored in plaintext and execution was not verified. Static read only, nothing executed. Live on npm with no OSV record as of 2026-10-17. All versions affected.
